title: Addressing Concerns from Students about Racial, Religious and Gender Discrimination amongst Educators
what_it_is: Addressing Concerns from Students about Racial, Religious and Gender Discrimination amongst Educators

sections.label: Racist views in education
sections.summary: Asked what avenues exist to flag educators with racist views early and whether safeguards protect those giving feedback from victimisation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) what avenues are available in educational institutions to ensure that educators with racist views will be flagged up at the earliest possible opportunity; and (b) whether safeguards are available to ensure that persons giving feedback do not fear victimisation or being disadvantaged especially if they choose not to do it anonymously so that they can be informed of the outcome of their feedback.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: To maintain this common space, our institutions stand firmly against any form of discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Our institutions have clear guidelines against unprofessional and discriminatory conduct.

sections.label: Reporting discrimination feedback channels
sections.summary: Students and staff experiencing discrimination should report it immediately through senior staff, email channels and other formal feedback mechanisms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Students and staff who experience any form of discrimination should not hesitate to bring it up to their institution immediately.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Feedback channels and processes for students to do so include approaching senior staff or faculty members in person, or via email channels and other formal feedback mechanisms.

sections.label: Anonymous feedback and protection
sections.summary: Students and staff may remain anonymous, but are encouraged to identify themselves; they are assured of support, protection and confidential handling.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: While students and staff can choose to remain anonymous when providing feedback or reporting any incident, we generally encourage them to identify themselves and provide their contact details so that a more thorough investigation can be conducted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Students and staff have the assurance that they will be supported and protected, and that their feedback will be handled sensitively and in strict confidence.

sections.label: Investigation and discipline process
sections.summary: Individuals involved are interviewed and evidence gathered; those who breached the Code of Conduct will be disciplined and counselled.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Individuals involved in the incident will be interviewed and evidence gathered, to ascertain the facts of the case.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Those found to have breached the Code of Conduct will be disciplined and counselled accordingly.
